snippet.title: Wonderfall — Steam Next Fest Trailer - The MIX Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Steam Next Fest is around the corner, new trailer!

Paris, 1920. In this story-rich narrative adventure game, a mysterious force called Entropy is turning the city into sand.

Demo available now on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3248790/Wonderfall/

Wonderfall is an atmospheric indie adventure set in a reimagined Paris as it slowly disappears. Play as Léon, a young orphan who gradually discovers his ability to shape sand.

Explore the historic Île de la Cité, from the Cité métro station to the rooftops of the city and Notre Dame de Paris, uncovering what happened to a city that has already begun to fall.

Traverse collapsing streets, discover hidden interiors, solve environmental challenges, and slip past corrupted entities as you search for the truth behind Entropy.

✨ Wishlist Wonderfall on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3248790/Wonderfall/

Official website: https://www.attaboy-interactive.com
X: https://x.com/game_wonderfall
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/game_wonderfall/
Discord: https://discord.gg/mBsrJrahPv

About Wonderfall

Wonderfall is a story-driven narrative adventure game where exploration reveals fragments of a collapsing world. Set in a reimagined Paris, 1920, players explore iconic locations including Notre Dame de Paris, Sainte-Chapelle, the Palais de Justice, and the Cité métro station as Entropy consumes the city.
